pages.title: Below and above
text: Three hunters own the March's caves, and they rise in the dark there by day as readily as by night. A fourth drifts over the high lands at night.
None of them will bond. Each drops **1 to 2** of its reagent, more with Looting.

pages.title: Deep Lurker
text: A star-nosed mole the size of a bear, the toughest of the cave hunters, found under every land of the March, one or two at a time. It has **32 health** and **3 armour** and bites for **5**.
It drops **Lurker Claws**, a Hound reagent that grinds into light blue dye.
Hunted, it also drops up to 2 Bones and up to 1 March Leather.

pages.title: Pale Stalker
text: A gaunt, eyeless cave ghoul, tall, pale and quick, of the caves under the Steppe, the Highlands, the Glimmer Ridge, the Snow Fields and the Crystal Fields, one or two at a time. **24 health** and **1 armour**. Its blow does **4** and weakens you for 4 seconds.
It drops **Pale Fangs**, a Weaken reagent.
Hunted, it also drops 1 to 2 Bones.

pages.title: Gloom Crawler
text: A cave centipede, low and dark, of the caves under every land but the Shallows, one or two at a time. **22 health** and **2 armour**. Its bite does **4**, slows you for 3 seconds and can leave you [Frayed](afflictions).
It drops **Gloom Silk**, a Weave reagent.
Hunted, it also drops 1 to 2 String and up to 1 Spider Eye.

pages.title: Veil Drifter
text: A drifting, tattered shroud on bat-like wings that rises at night over the Highlands, the Glimmer Ridge, the Snow Fields and the Crystal Fields, one or two at a time. **18 health** and **1 armour**.
From up to 12 blocks away it casts a gust for **3** that throws you back. Cover breaks the cast. It drops **Veil Tatters**, a Gust reagent.
Hunted, it also drops up to 1 Phantom Membrane and up to 1 String.

pages.title: Hunting and herding
text: Besides its reagent, each one drops more when hunted, and more again with Looting.
